CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  October 28, 2025

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – October 14, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the October 14, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the October 14, 2025, Regular Meeting
  of the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-093
  • 1401 South Garfield Avenue
  • Applicant: John Crispis
  • Request: This is an application for new wall signage and exterior
  building graphics on an existing 1-story commercial building and
  canopy structures for a gas station known as ‘Gulf’.
  1
  10/28/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-086
  • 115 West Main Street
  • Applicant: Christopher Kim
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall sign and the refacing
  of an existing illuminated blade design for an existing commercial
  tenant space occupied by a restaurant known as “Sushi Yu”.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-136
  • 127 Westmont Drive
  • Applicant: Jasen Lam
  • Request: This is an application for one new window and the
  replacement of selected windows and one exterior door on an existing
  single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

  2
  10/28/2025
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Windows #W1, W2, W12, and W13, as identified on the plans,
  to maintain a wood frame material.
  2. Revise the proposed color of the exterior window trim, door
  frame, and door panel to a dark brown tone color.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-130
  • 807 Lindaraxa Park North
  • Applicant: Gabriel Flores
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations of an existing
  2-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the plans to clearly indicate that the proposed siding
  will be installed over the existing stucco exterior.
  2. The proposed trim color may be black as presented.
  Alternatively, if the owner elects to use a dark brown or dark
  green tone for the trim, the project shall not be required to
  return to the Design Review Board for further review.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-120
  • 1127 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Frank Wright
  • Request: This is an application for exterior alterations and
  improvements to an existing commercial tenant space for the
  business known as “Handel's Ice Cream”.
  3
  10/28/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Mural #4, as indicated on Sheet A104, shall either be removed
  from the plan set, or shall be clearly identified on the plans
  where the proposed location is.
  2. Provide a north elevation of the adjacent building to the south,
  where a Mural #3 is proposed to be painted.
  3. Remove the additional/typo placement of Mural #3 on Sheet
  A101.
  4. The applicant shall work with City staff to incorporate planter
  boxes as part of the Outdoor Dining Permit. The final design
  and placement of the planter boxes shall be reviewed and
  approved by the City Architect and Planning staff.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Revise the proposed awning material to be acrylic and update
  all plan sheets accordingly for consistency throughout the
  project.
  2. The applicant shall either remove the “Boathouse” text from
  the building depicted on Mural #4, or replace the “Boathouse”
  building with an equally iconic and contextually appropriate
  building within the City of Alhambra, such as “The Hat”. If the
  building is replaced on Mural #4, then it shall be reviewed and
  approved by City Staff.
  3. Mural #4, as indicated on Sheet A104, shall be clearly
  identified on the plans.
  4. Provide a north elevation of the adjacent building to the south,
  where Mural #4 is proposed to be painted.
  5. The applicant shall work with City staff to incorporate planter
  boxes as part of the Outdoor Dining Permit. The final design
  and placement of the planter boxes shall be reviewed and
  approved by the City Architect and Planning staff.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

AGENDA
ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-142
  • 1127 South Fremont Avenue
  • Applicant: Frank Wright
  • Request: This is an application for modifications to the existing
  Alhambra Retail Center Master Sign Program and new tenant
  4
  10/28/2025
   signage for an existing commercial tenant space for the business
  known as “Handels Ice Cream”.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Center the proposed southeast corner wall sign horizontally
  between the top of parapet and the top of awning feature as
  indicated under sign type ‘S2’ under the Alhambra Retail
  Center Master Sign Program.
  2. Provide a dimension from the finished floor to the centerline
  of the proposed blade sign to confirm the height is 19’-9” as
  indicated under sign type ‘S5’ under the Alhambra Retail
  Center Master Sign Program.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Center the proposed southeast corner wall sign horizontally
  between the top of parapet and the top of awning feature as
  indicated under sign type ‘S2’ under the Alhambra Retail
  Center Master Sign Program.
  2. Provide a dimension from the finished floor to the centerline
  of the proposed blade sign to confirm the height is 19’-9” as
  indicated under sign type ‘S5’ under the Alhambra Retail
  Center Master Sign Program.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Hernandez

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

  F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:51 P.M. to

  Nora Hernandez
